descriptions.w3d_worm_graphic_random_animation: Selects one of four animations when the message player matches an eligible worm graphic.
descriptions.w3d_worm_graphic_set_blink: Reads the Worm.Blink setting when the message entity matches and stores it as a boolean.
descriptions.w3d_worm_graphic_release_effect: Releases the held effect and clears its pointer.
